h: Judy Austin reacts after Yul Edochie shares throwback clips featuring May
p: Judy Austin has reportedly reacted to throwback videos posted by actor Yul Edochie that feature his first wife, May. The reaction has sparked debate among fans online about the long-running family saga.
more: Yul Edochie recently shared old clips from his earlier years with May.
The saga has remained a frequent talking point on Nigerian social media.
Neither side has said more beyond the online reactions.
